name: Smith Machine Incline Reverse-Grip Bench Press
steps: Angle the bench so the bar tracks over your upper chest and lie back with your feet planted.
Take a full underhand grip just outside shoulder width, set your shoulders against the pad and release the hooks.
Lower the bar slowly toward your upper-to-mid chest while keeping your elbows tucked tightly close to your sides.
Press the bar smoothly straight back up to lockout, then rerack carefully when finished.
tips: Keep your wrists aligned with your forearms as you lower the bar.
Keep your elbows tucked in front of your ribs to reduce shoulder stress and emphasize the upper chest.
